# ProxyGosha

> Zero-cost, single-file Telegram WEB Proxy running on Cloudflare Workers. Unblock Telegram Desktop with no VPS, no maintenance, and 100% free serverless infrastructure.

## Overview
ProxyGosha turns a free Cloudflare Worker (`worker.js`) into a personal Telegram Desktop WEB proxy server. It listens on port 443 over HTTPS and WebSockets, serves a deceptive decoy webpage to general HTTP traffic, and tunnels MTProto traffic directly to Telegram data centers (DCs) using raw TCP sockets (`cloudflare:sockets`).

## Key Features
- **Zero Cost & Serverless**: Runs completely on Cloudflare's free tier (100,000 requests/day).
- **Single File (`worker.js`)**: Pure JavaScript ES Module without external dependencies or npm build steps.
- **Stealth Decoy Landing Page**: Browser requests receive an innocent decoy webpage.
- **One-Click Deployment**: Paste the script into the Cloudflare dashboard, configure environment variables, and connect.
- **Direct-to-DC Tunneling**: Decodes Obfuscated2 / MTProto framing and establishes low-latency TCP connections to Telegram DCs.

## Technical Specifications
- **Runtime**: Cloudflare Workers (V8 JavaScript isolate).
- **Transport**: HTTPS & WSS (WebSocket Secure, Port 443).
- **Socket Driver**: `cloudflare:sockets` TCP outbound socket.
- **Protocol**: Telegram Desktop "WEB" proxy carrier (Bridge protocol) + MTProto Obfuscated2.
- **Client Compatibility**: Telegram Desktop (Windows, macOS, Linux). Not supported on mobile clients (Android/iOS) due to Telegram client-side protocol limits.
- **Middle-End & Ad Tags**: Sponsored channel ad tags (ME route) are incompatible with Cloudflare Workers due to dynamic NAPT source port translation in Cloudflare's egress network; ProxyGosha uses direct DC routing.

## Environment Variables
- `SECRET`: 32-character hexadecimal secret for proxy authentication (required).
- `HOSTNAME`: Optional allowlist of permitted hostname headers.
- `DEBUG`: Set to `"true"` to enable diagnostic logs (optional).

## Client Link Format
Telegram Web Proxy link format:
`tg://webproxy?server=<YOUR_CUSTOM_DOMAIN>&secret=<YOUR_HEX_SECRET>`
